title: Child Safety
subtitle: Monitor screen time, set filters, and protect your children online.
chatRiskSubtitle: AI summarizes risky patterns without exposing raw private messages.
noChatRisks: No risky chat patterns detected recently.
safetyTipsTeen1: Never share OTPs, passwords, or personal info with anyone online — even if they claim to be from a company or government.
safetyTipsTeen2: Think before you click — suspicious links in messages or emails can steal your data.
safetyTipsTeen3: If something feels wrong online, tell a trusted adult immediately.
safetyTipsKid1: Never tell strangers your real name, school, or where you live.
safetyTipsKid2: If someone online makes you feel scared or uncomfortable, tell your parents right away.
safetyTipsKid3: Only use apps and websites your parents have approved.
noChildrenDesc: Link your children's accounts to monitor their online safety and set age-appropriate restrictions.
